children: Saudi low-cost carrier Flynas has signed agreements to acquire a 10% equity interest in Swissport Saudi Arabia Limited for $13.33 million (SAR 50 million).

In connection with the transaction, Flynas has entered into a five-year ground handling agreement with Swissport Saudi Arabia Limited, under which the company will provide ground handling services at all commercial airports across Saudi Arabia.

As part of the shareholders’ agreement (SHA), Flynas has secured a call option to acquire an additional 10% stake in Swissport Saudi Arabia upon the renewal of the ground handling agreement, potentially increasing its holding to 20%.
The transaction also includes a minimal variable equity consideration, to be calculated in accordance with the mechanism specified in the agreements., the company said in a filing.

The agreement is scheduled to take effect on March 6, 2027, and remain in force until March 1, 2032, with an option for renewal for an additional five-year term. The transaction will be financed from Flynas’ internal resources.
Substantial shareholders in Flynas are National Aviation Ground Support Company and Kingdom Holding Company holding 27.74% and 27.44% stakes respectively, according to LSEG data.
The selling shareholders are Swissport International AG and Asyad Holding, a family conglomerate based in the kingdom.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Daniel Luiz)

title: Saudi Flynas acquires 10% stake in Swissport Saudi Arabia for $13mln
